title.narrative: Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation (CAREC) Corridor 2 Road Investment Program - Tranche 3

description.narrative: A multitranche financing facility for the Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation (CAREC) Corridor 2 Road Investment Program (the investment program) was approved in April 2010 for an aggregate amount of $600 million. The third tranche (Loan 2868-UZB) of the investment program was approved in June 2012 for $100 million from the Asian Development Fund. The project will lead to better connectivity and an efficient transport system along the Uzbekistan section of the CAREC Corridor 2 road. The project outcome will be the reconstructed A380 highway section and crossborder facilities with improved travel time and efficiency. The project outputs are (i) an approximately 40 km of the reconstructed Uzbekistan section of CAREC Corridor 2 road (between Km315 and Km355 of A380 highway), (ii) improved cross-border facilities, and (iii) community development.

Output: Community development Indicator: By 2016: Public awareness campaign on gender and development issues as well as on negative externalities such as transmission of communicable diseases and human trafficking, completed covering 500 people. Progress/Status: Completed in August 2016. A session dedicated to gender equality principles was developed and delivered as part of the training workshop held for the communities of Gazli, Romitan and Bukhara. In addition, handouts with information on gender awareness were distributed in print form and on CDs to 142 participants. Also, a training session was developed and delivered at the training workshop held for the project communities, and handouts with information on HIV/AIDS and STDs were distributed in print form and on CDs to 142 beneficiaries. Data Source: Road Fund website Actual value:

Output: Uzbekistan section of CAREC Corridor 2 road reconstructed Indicator: By 2016: 40 km road sections reconstructed with pavement international roughness index of less than 4m/km from 8m/km in 2010 Progress/Status: The civil works commenced in May 2014 and completed in December 2016. The taking-over certificate inspection was conducted in December 2016 and certificate of performance is expected to be issued in Q2-2018.

Output: Community development Indicator: A needs assessment report on gender and development prepared. Progress/Status: The training needs assessment was carried out in July 2016 in Romitan and Bukhara districts of Bukhara Province, among the members of the communities surrounding the project. The assessment was conducted using a semi-structured questionnaire among women and men from the communities surrounding the project in Bukhara and Romitan districts, who plan to start their own businesses, as well as with key informants consisting of the representatives of the local WCU, khokimiyats, and mahallas. The final report was submitted to ADB in November 2016 includes findings of the needs assessment.
